data.one_liner: An efficient on-tap bounce animation wrapper widget for static and scrolling pages.
data.what_it_does: Wraps any Flutter widget to provide an on-tap bounce animation effect. Works efficiently on both static pages and scrollable pages without sticking during scroll gestures.
use_when: You want a bouncy tactile feedback when tapping buttons or cards
You need tap bounce animations inside scrollable lists or grids without blocking scrolling
avoid_when: You need fine-grained control via a scaleFactor property, which this package lacks
strengths: Works well inside scrollable pages without interfering with scroll gestures
weaknesses: Lacks a scaleFactor parameter for custom scale customization
Mandatory requirement for child, duration, and onPressed parameters
data.minimal_example:
Bounce(
  duration: Duration(milliseconds: 110),
  onPressed: () { YOUR_FUNCTION },
  child: YOUR_WIDGET,
)
